# Physics-Collaboration-Buddy-System
Tools to help organising a buddy system for networking in larhe physics collaborations

**match-maker.ipynb** is the main notebook which contains code to partially automate the match making process

**make-fake-data.py** will generate a csv full of test data that can be used to test the match-maker notebook

**test_data.csv** is an example of participant responses generated by make-fake-data.py that can be used for testing
